name: dsh-live-model-catalog
description: DSH 插件：让 llm-pi-ai 路由（含自定义服务商）的模型目录与推理档位跟着端点更新——补上新模型与 contextWindow/maxTokens/input/reasoningEfforts，端点给出推理信息即写入思考档位，并修好「获取可用模型」按钮；只走官方 settings 接缝，不打补丁、可卸载。| DSH plugin: keeps llm-pi-ai routes (hand-written and custom providers included) in step with their own /models: new models, capabilities, reasoning levels, live fetch button. No patching.
